subject: LAT
title: Survey of Latin Literature
info: 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated for a total of 6 undergraduate hours or 8 graduate hours in separate semesters, if topics vary. Prerequisite: LAT 202 or four years of high school Latin.

sections.sectionText: Apuleius - In this class, we will be reading selections from Apuleius' 'Metamorphoses' (also called 'The Golden Ass') This work explores themes of curiosity, witchcraft, transformation, animality, and religious conversion through the figure of Lucius, a man who accidentally turns himself into a donkey and remains trapped in this body through various trials and adventures.
